```json
[
  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Test Reporting Proximal Tube Connection", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-103"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"controller_status": "connected"}, "steps": ["Verify that the controller reports a connected status for the proximal tube"], "expected": ["Controller reports the proximal tube as connected"]},
  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Test Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm Activation", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-104"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Controller reports the proximal tube as connected"], "inputs": {"proximal_tube_status": "disconnected"}, "steps": ["Simulate a disconnection of the proximal tube and verify that the 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm is activated"], "expected": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Test Medium Priority of Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-105"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"], "inputs": {"alarm_priority": "medium"}, "steps": ["Check the priority level of the 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm"], "expected": ["Alarm priority is correctly set to medium"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Test Obstruction Alarm Activation", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-107"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"], "inputs": {"VTI": 90}, "steps": ["Simulate a VTI less than 100ml and verify that the 'obstruction' alarm is activated"], "expected": ["Obstruction alarm is inactive, as VTI is less than 100ml"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Test Obstruction Alarm Deactivation", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-107"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"], "inputs": {"VTI": 100}, "steps": ["Simulate a VTI exactly 100ml and verify that the 'obstruction' alarm is inactive"], "expected": ["Obstruction alarm remains inactive, as VTI is exactly 100ml"]},
  {"id": "TC-101", "title": "Test High Priority of Obstruction Alarm", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-109"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"], "inputs": {"alarm_priority": "high"}, "steps": ["Check the priority level of the 'obstruction' alarm"], "expected": ["Alarm priority is correctly set to high"]},
  {"id": "TC-102", "title": "Test Computation of Leakage Amount", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-110"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"], "inputs": {"sensor_readings": "leakage_data"}, "steps": ["Calculate the leakage rate (L/min) based on sensor readings"], "expected": ["Leakage rate is correctly computed from the sensor data"]},
  {"id": "TC-103", "title": "Test Leakage Amount Computation with No Obstruction", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-110"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'proximal tube disconnect' is active"], "inputs": {"sensor_readings": "no_leakage"}, "steps": ["Calculate the leakage rate (L/min) with no leakage data"], "expected": ["Leakage rate should not be computed or should default to a safe value as no leakage is detected"]},
  {"id": "TC-104", "title": "Test Leakage Amount Computation with Obstruction Detected", "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-110"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Alarm for 'obstruction' is active"], "inputs": {"sensor_readings": "leakage_data_with_obstruction"}, "steps": ["Calculate the leakage rate (L/min) with leakage data and obstruction detected"], "expected": ["Leakage rate is correctly computed considering the obstruction"]}
]
```

Note: The above JSON test cases assume the existence of a Python testing framework like pytest and that the system under test provides a way to simulate the controller status, alarm states, and priority levels. The actual implementation would require integration with the system's specific APIs and interfaces. The "inputs" and "expected" fields should be replaced with concrete values or mock data as per the actual system's capabilities. The "steps" field should contain the specific actions taken in the test, which would typically involve calling methods on the system under test and asserting the expected outcomes. The "preconditions" field is used to set up the necessary state before each test, which may involve initializing mock objects or setting up test data. The "kind" field indicates whether the test is a positive case (expected to pass), negative case (expected to fail), or boundary case (testing at the limits). The "expected" field should contain the expected outcome that the test asserts against, which should be a concrete, checkable result as per the requirement text.

Please ensure that the actual system under test and the testing framework support these operations, and adjust the test cases accordingly. The test suite provided here is a conceptual representation based on the requirements and should be adapted to the specific context of the system being tested.
